intro: This source-backed comparison evaluates Raspberry Pi 5 and Intel NUC 13 Pro for a growing small office balancing performance and total cost. It focuses on stable technical characteristics, deployment fit, interfaces, form factor, and operational trade-offs. It does not copy volatile prices, stock, star ratings, or unverified user claims.
verdict: Choose Raspberry Pi 5 when learning, automation, lightweight services, and compact lab nodes is the leading requirement. Choose Intel NUC 13 Pro when compact x86 lab nodes and business desktops matters more. For a growing small office balancing performance and total cost, verify compatibility, support, current availability, and workload limits in the cited manufacturer documentation before purchase. The renewed M920q is the value reference at an estimated USD 240; the live listing determines the exact configuration and final price.
